channel.title: The Dig — Application benchmarks
channel.description: Papers relevant to operating, benchmarking, integrating and using a semiconductor spin-qubit quantum computer of at least 16 qubits that is co-located with and integrated into an HPC system. Today's arXiv announcement, ranked against the Application benchmarks preset. Today's ranked reading list centers on quantum error correction decoding and scalable architectures, led by 2611.34481 on GPU-based real-time decoding of bivariate bicycle codes, followed by 2611.33665 on a 2D FPGA Union-Find decoder, 2611.34891 on neural-network decoders for qubit loss, 2611.32560 on low-energy subspace sampling for QAOA benchmarks, 2611.33590 on a dense silicon spin-qubit architecture with logical operations, and 2611.33389 on constructive embedding and routing of QEC codes.
